categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Matches the P2P label, modifies src/net_processing.cpp, and directly addresses peer connection and message relay accounting.
categories.rationale: Prevents inbound peers from bypassing inbound transaction-relay capacity accounting by advertising fRelay=false while issuing BIP35 mempool requests on nodes offering NODE_BLOOM. Resource accounting and DoS resistance in message handling are primary concerns in P2P, making the fix to this capacity circumvention strategically important.
